title: analytics: the draft preview does not refuse a `{ $field }` reference to the tenant-isolation column, which both live faces refuse 400
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As6JrAPNfuwC2RLXXGu

Found while landing #36677 (PR #37299, head `8a7f8ff4`; dev report: #36677 comment 7164500720, `open_questions[0]`).

## What happens

After #37299, the analytics draft preview (`queryDataset` with `previewDrafts`) resolves a `{ $field }` comparand the way the live faces do, with one gap left open on purpose: the tenant-isolation column is not judged. `{ label: { $eq: { $field: 'organization_id' } } }` is refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 by the native and ObjectQL faces (driver-sql reads the tenant column off the object schema through `resolveTenantFieldName` in `@objectstack/core`), but the preview compares it like any text column (measured count 2 on the PR's fixture). The preview is handed only a field's declared shape (`sourceFieldMeta`), so it has no tenant-column fact. The PR's test excludes the two tenant rows of `CROSS_FIELD_REFUSALS` by name (`preview-field-reference-36677.test.ts`, `TENANT_ROWS`).

Re-check: `grep -n "TENANT_ROWS" packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/preview-field-reference-36677.test.ts` on main after #37299 merges.

## Options (from the dev report; for triage, not a ruling)

- A: add an optional config reader (for example `tenantFieldOf(object)`) to `AnalyticsServiceConfig`, wired by `AnalyticsServicePlugin` from `resolveTenantFieldName(engine.getObject(object))`; the preview refuses that column on either side. Small, but widens an exported type, so it needs a contract judgement.
- B: refuse a reference to `DEFAULT_TENANT_FIELD` by name. No export change; over-refuses a tenancy-disabled object that declares `organization_id` and misses a custom `tenancy.tenantField`.
- C: leave it as a known boundary of the preview.

Dev recommendation: A (one tenancy predicate, preview equals live faces). Seat note: the live faces already refuse, so the gap only shows a count on the preview where publish would show a 400; no data leaves the tenant (the preview reads draft seed rows only).

Responsibility: platform code (`packages/services/service-analytics`, this repo); no platform path covers it today; reached by a Studio author writing a field-to-field filter on the tenant column in preview mode.
